title: Frame panel: wire motion tween Rotate/Scale/Orient/Sync controls into Timeline bottom bar
description:
The model keyframe (types.ts) has four motion-tween properties that are fully wired through getTweenedFrame/interpolateTween but are completely inaccessible from the authoring UI:

- motionRotate: "none" | "auto" | "cw" | "ccw" — controls whether rotation is interpolated (auto = shortest path, cw/ccw = enforced direction)
- motionRotateCount: number — extra full rotations to add on top of interpolated angle
- motionOrientToPath: boolean — aligns object tangent to its motion guide path
- motionScale: boolean — whether scale is interpolated (true by default)

The Timeline bottom bar (Timeline.tsx ~L1713) currently only exposes Ease (number input) and Custom... (ease curve dialog) for motion tweens. Flash 8's Frame properties panel also shows: Rotate select (none/auto/CW/CCW), Rotate count spinner, Orient to path checkbox, Sync checkbox, and Scale checkbox.

## Work
1. Extend the motion-tween row in Timeline.tsx to add:
   - Rotate dropdown (none/auto/CW/CCW) + count input (only when rotate ≠ none)
   - Orient to path checkbox (only when layer type is 'guided')
   - Scale checkbox
   - Sync checkbox
2. Wire each control back to setMotionTween (or a thin model mutation that patches the keyframe fields).
3. Extend timeline_set_tween MCP tool in agent/registry.ts to accept rotate/rotateCount/orientToPath/sync/scale in the props bag so agents can set these.

## Acceptance
- Flash 8 FLA with motionRotate='cw' + rotateCount=2 round-trips correctly through the UI.
- orient-to-path checkbox is visible only on guided layers and affects canvas preview rotation.
- All new controls call onTimelineChange (history entry created).
